infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: HOP uses Bluetooth to find nearby HOP users and exchange a message when Nearby is open.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: HOP uses Bluetooth to be discoverable by nearby HOP users while Nearby is open.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: HOP records short voice messages you send to other HOP users.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: HOP talks to your development API on the local network when EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL is your Mac LAN address. Nearby uses Bluetooth, not Wi-Fi multicast.
